title: Create a guide for React InstantSearch here: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/search/instant-search/
body:
Steps:

- [x] create the same demo than https://demo.algolia.com/examples/instant-search/jquery/ but with react-instantsearch
- [x] create a new `react-instantsearch` section for the Instant Search Result Page guide using snippet from the previous demo.
